records.source: Why, hello and welcome to our little community, dear! #$b#You can call me 'Granny' if you like.$h
records.translation: Aba, kumusta at maligayang pagdating sa munting komunidad natin, mahal! #$b#Maaari mo akong tawaging “Lola” kung gusto mo.$h

records.source: Oh, you're giving this to me? Thank you so much, dear. This is a really special gift!
records.translation: Ah, ibinibigay mo ito sa akin? Maraming-maraming salamat, mahal. Talagang natatangi ang regalong ito!

records.source: Thank you, dear. I've been looking everywhere for my reading glasses...#$b#My, my! They've become filthy...
records.translation: Salamat, mahal. Hinahanap ko kung saan-saan ang salamin ko sa pagbabasa...#$b#Naku po! Napakarumi na nito...

records.source: George, dear... Is this the end? It's been a good life, but I'd like to see Alex find his way before departing...$s%noturn
records.translation: George, mahal... Ito na ba ang wakas? Naging maganda ang buhay, pero gusto kong makita munang matagpuan ni Alex ang landas niya bago ako lumisan...$s%noturn

records.source: Oh, my dear... I'm so glad everything ended up okay. And my flowers look healthier than ever!
records.translation: Ah, mahal ko... Natutuwa akong naging maayos ang lahat. At mas malusog ang mga bulaklak ko kaysa dati!

records.source: The flowers seem to love this rain...
records.translation: Mukhang gustong-gusto ng mga bulaklak ang ulang ito...

records.source: Thank you, dear. This brings back such sweet memories...
records.translation: Salamat, mahal. Ibinabalik nito ang mga napakatamis na alaala...

records.source: Oh, I'm sure George would be interested in that!
records.translation: Ah, tiyak akong magiging interesado si George riyan!

records.source: Home-grown tulips make for a lovely springtime gift.
records.translation: Napakagandang regalo sa tagsibol ang mga Tulip na itinanim sa sariling bakuran.

records.source: It's lovely to have the old community center back. We have so many memories from the old days... It's a special place.
records.translation: Napakagandang maibalik ang lumang Sentro ng Komunidad. Napakarami naming alaala mula noong araw... Natatanging lugar iyon.

records.source: I'm very happy for you, dear.$h#$e#Seeing young people in love is heartwarming for old grannies like me.
records.translation: Napakasaya ko para sa iyo, mahal.$h#$e#Pinaiinit ang puso ng matatandang lolang tulad ko kapag nakikita ang mga kabataang nagmamahalan.

records.source: Next time you marry, make sure it's the right one...$s
records.translation: Sa susunod na magpakasal ka, tiyakin mong siya ang tamang tao...$s

records.source: That's a very pretty rose, dear. Have you shown it to Emily? It makes me think of her.
records.translation: Napakagandang rosas niyan, mahal. Naipakita mo na ba kay Emily? Ipinaaalala nito sa akin si Emily.

records.source: Oh, sweetie... that was so nice of you to put Pam up in a beautiful new house!$h#$e#It warms my heart when people take care of each other like that...
records.translation: Ah, mahal... Napakabait mong pinatira si Pam sa isang magandang bagong bahay!$h#$e#Pinaiinit ang puso ko kapag nag-aalaga nang ganoon ang mga tao sa isa’t isa...

records.source: Call me a silly old fool... but I think I have an idea who paid for Pam's new house... *wink*
records.translation: Tawagin mo na akong hangal na matanda... pero sa tingin ko ay may ideya ako kung sino ang nagbayad para sa bagong bahay ni Pam... *kindat*

records.source: Oh my! That's so kind of you, dear. Why yes... I'd love to go to the movies!$h#$b#You go on ahead, and I'll meet you at the theater.
records.translation: Naku po! Napakabait mo, mahal. Aba, oo... Gustong-gusto kong manood ng sine!$h#$b#Mauna ka na at magkita tayo sa sinehan.

records.source: Oh my! What a lovely day.$u
records.translation: Naku po! Napakagandang araw.$u

records.source: Don't mind my husband, George. He isn't very friendly to strangers.#$e#If you get to know him better he'll warm up to you.#$e#I'm sure you two could become good friends one day!$h#$e#Since you're so interested in my husband I'll let you in on a little secret: he really likes leeks! You can find them in the mountains this time of year.
records.translation: Huwag mong intindihin ang asawa kong si George. Hindi siya gaanong palakaibigan sa mga estranghero.#$e#Kapag mas nakilala mo siya, magiging palagay din siya sa iyo.#$e#Tiyak akong magiging matalik kayong magkaibigan balang-araw!$h#$e#Dahil interesado ka sa asawa ko, sasabihin ko sa iyo ang isang munting lihim: gustong-gusto niya ang Leek! Makakakita ka ng mga iyon sa kabundukan sa panahong ito ng taon.

records.source: #$1 evelynGarden1#I saw the most beautiful family of butterflies sunning themselves in the town garden yesterday.$k#$e#The good Mayor put me in charge of the town's public gardens.#$e#I've been working on the town flower beds for weeks, so don't step on them!
records.translation: #$1 evelynGarden1#Nakita ko kahapon ang napakagandang pamilya ng mga paruparong nagpapaaraw sa hardin ng bayan.$k#$e#Ipinagkatiwala sa akin ng mabuting Mayor ang mga pampublikong hardin ng bayan.#$e#Ilang linggo ko nang inaayos ang mga taniman ng bulaklak sa bayan, kaya huwag mong tapakan ang mga iyon!

records.source: I'll be baking cookies today. I like to make flower shapes in the spring.$h#$e#Maybe I'll tell you my recipe one of these days.
records.translation: Maghuhurno ako ng mga biskuwit ngayon. Gusto kong hubugin ang mga iyon na parang bulaklak tuwing tagsibol.$h#$e#Baka sabihin ko sa iyo ang resipe ko balang-araw.

records.source: George spends the whole day in front of that darned television set.#$e#I wish he'd go outside more. Some fresh air would do him good.
records.translation: Buong araw na nakaupo si George sa harap ng kainis-inis na telebisyon.#$e#Sana ay mas madalas siyang lumabas. Makabubuti sa kanya ang sariwang hangin.

records.source: I used to love looking at the clouds, but I have trouble seeing them these days.#$e# My eyes just don't work as well as they used to.$s
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong tumingin sa mga ulap noon, pero nahihirapan na akong makita ang mga iyon ngayon.#$e# Hindi na kasinglinaw ng dati ang mga mata ko.$s

records.source: It's nice to be so close to the ocean. The sound of the sea makes going to sleep a lot easier.#$e#As kids we hunted for seashells after the tide went out. Those were the days...
records.translation: Masarap mamuhay nang malapit sa karagatan. Pinadadali ng tunog ng dagat ang pagtulog.#$e#Noong bata kami, naghahanap kami ng mga kabibe kapag umurong ang tubig. Masasayang panahon iyon...

records.source: It's nice of you to take the time to visit George and I.#$e#Without young people around, we'd age much faster.$h
records.translation: Napakabait mong maglaan ng oras upang dalawin kami ni George.#$e#Kung walang mga kabataang kasama, mas mabilis kaming tatanda.$h

records.source: Thank you!$h
records.translation: Salamat!$h

records.source: What was that, dear? I could've sworn you said 'hockey puck'. *sigh* My ears aren't what they used to be.$s
records.translation: Ano iyon, mahal? Maipapanunumpa kong sinabi mong “puck ng hockey”. *buntong-hininga* Hindi na kasinglinaw ng dati ang pandinig ko.$s

records.source: I feel more energetic in this wonderful weather.$u
records.translation: Mas masigla ako sa napakagandang panahong ito.$u

records.source: How's my grandson doing? I imagine he's quite happy living on the farm.#$e#He deserves to be happy... he's a good boy.
records.translation: Kumusta ang apo kong lalaki? Palagay ko ay napakasaya niyang tumira sa bukid.#$e#Karapat-dapat siyang sumaya... mabuti siyang bata.

records.source: George is always a little less grumpy in the summer. The warm weather softens his bones.#$e#You might not be able to tell, but I can. I've known him for sixty years!
records.translation: Laging hindi gaanong mainitin ang ulo ni George sa tag-init. Pinapalambot ng mainit na panahon ang mga buto niya.#$e#Baka hindi mo mapansin, pero napapansin ko. Animnapung taon ko na siyang kilala!

records.source: The good Mayor put me in charge of the town's public gardens.#$e#I've been working on the town flower beds for months, so don't step on them!
records.translation: Ipinagkatiwala sa akin ng mabuting Mayor ang mga pampublikong hardin ng bayan.#$e#Ilang buwan ko nang inaayos ang mga taniman ng bulaklak sa bayan, kaya huwag mong tapakan ang mga iyon!

records.source: I'm going to bake cookies today. They're coconut wonders shaped like little palm trees! Heehee.$h#$e#Maybe I'll tell you my recipe one of these days.
records.translation: Maghuhurno ako ng mga biskuwit ngayon. Kahanga-hanga ang mga biskuwit na ito: may niyog at hugis maliliit na punong palma! Heehee.$h#$e#Baka sabihin ko sa iyo ang resipe ko balang-araw.

records.source: Be careful out there, dear. You could get sunburnt!
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka roon, mahal. Baka masunog ka sa araw!

records.source: Sweet peas are in bloom right now.#$e#They've got such a wonderful fragrance, haven't they?
records.translation: Namumulaklak ngayon ang Sweet Pea.#$e#Napakabango ng mga iyon, hindi ba?

records.source: It seems like we always have more visitors when I start baking cookies.#$e#My mother taught me the recipe.
records.translation: Mukhang laging mas marami ang bumibisita kapag nagsisimula akong maghurno ng mga biskuwit.#$e#Itinuro sa akin ni Nanay ang resipe.

records.source: With every year I appreciate the seasons more and more. For young people it's easy to let them slip by.
records.translation: Sa bawat taon, lalo kong pinahahalagahan ang mga panahon. Madaling hayaang lumipas ang mga iyon para sa mga kabataan.

records.source: I've been putting raisins in George's oatmeal... but he hasn't said a word. I wonder if he even notices these things?
records.translation: Nilalagyan ko ng pasas ang oatmeal ni George... pero wala siyang sinasabi. Iniisip ko kung napapansin pa ba niya ang mga bagay na ito?

records.source: The good Mayor put me in charge of the town's public gardens.#$e#The fall flowers are delicate, so don't go stomping on them! I know how you kids like to do.
records.translation: Ipinagkatiwala sa akin ng mabuting Mayor ang mga pampublikong hardin ng bayan.#$e#Maselan ang mga bulaklak sa taglagas, kaya huwag mong tapak-tapakan ang mga iyon! Alam ko kung ano ang hilig ninyong mga bata.

records.source: Today I'm baking cookies. They're shaped like little pumpkins.$h#$e#Maybe I'll tell you my recipe one of these days.
records.translation: Maghuhurno ako ng mga biskuwit ngayon. Hugis maliliit na kalabasa ang mga iyon.$h#$e#Baka sabihin ko sa iyo ang resipe ko balang-araw.

records.source: Are you friends with Alex?#$e#Sometime he worries me sick.
records.translation: Kaibigan mo ba si Alex?#$e#Kung minsan ay halos magkasakit ako sa pag-aalala sa kanya.

records.source: Oh, hello my dear. I think of you as my own ${grandson^grand-daughter}$ now.$h
records.translation: Ah, kumusta, mahal ko. Itinuturing na kitang sarili kong ${apo^apo}$ ngayon.$h

records.source: My eyesight may be poor, but my nose hasn't failed me yet!#$e#I can smell fallen leaves and mushrooms. It reminds me of the forests I used to play in as a girl.
records.translation: Maaaring mahina na ang paningin ko, pero hindi pa ako binibigo ng ilong ko!#$e#Naaamoy ko ang mga nalaglag na dahon at kabute. Ipinaaalala nito sa akin ang mga kagubatang pinaglaruan ko noong bata pa ako.

records.source: Be careful you don't slip on the ice, dear.
records.translation: Mag-ingat kang huwag madulas sa yelo, mahal.

records.source: Aren't you cold? You should wear a thicker jacket, my dear!#$e#This weather isn't good for my joints...$s
records.translation: Hindi ka ba nilalamig? Dapat magsuot ka ng mas makapal na dyaket, mahal ko!#$e#Hindi mabuti ang panahong ito para sa mga kasukasuan ko...$s

records.source: I usually tend to the gardens, but they're covered in snow.#$e#I still like to check up on them now and then.
records.translation: Karaniwan kong inaalagaan ang mga hardin, pero natatakpan ang mga iyon ng niyebe.#$e#Gusto ko pa ring tingnan ang kalagayan ng mga iyon paminsan-minsan.

records.source: Today I'm baking cookies. They're shaped like little winter stars.$h#$e#Maybe I'll tell you my recipe one of these days.
records.translation: Maghuhurno ako ng mga biskuwit ngayon. Hugis maliliit na Bituin ng Taglamig ang mga iyon.$h#$e#Baka sabihin ko sa iyo ang resipe ko balang-araw.

records.source: We've lived here for over 30 years.#$e#We've seen a lot of people come and go. Your grandfather, for one. Bless him... *sigh*
records.translation: Mahigit 30 taon na kaming nakatira rito.#$e#Marami na kaming nakitang dumating at umalis. Isa na ang Lolo mo. Pagpalain siya... *buntong-hininga*

records.source: Oh... my dear. You have your grandfather's eyes...$s#$e#Yes... yes... I knew him very well.
records.translation: Ah... mahal ko. Taglay mo ang mga mata ng lolo mo...$s#$e#Oo... oo... Kilalang-kilala ko siya.

records.source: You should make some hot soup to stay warm.#$e#And make sure you wear a jacket!
records.translation: Dapat kang gumawa ng mainit na sopas upang manatiling mainit.#$e#At tiyaking magsuot ka ng dyaket!

records.source: @, have I told you that George and I have lived in our house for 30 years?#$e#I hope you stay here for a while.$h
records.translation: @, nasabi ko na ba sa iyo na 30 taon na kaming nakatira ni George sa bahay namin?#$e#Sana ay manatili ka rito nang matagal.$h
